name: tali-dash-plugins
description: the maintainer's DSH plugins, recipes and deployment tooling. Scripts: bootstrap (fresh-machine installer, tools/bootstrap-mac.sh); bootstrap-remote user@host [flags] (same, over ssh; --replace redeploys a deploy-remote host); install-plugins / remove-plugins [--profile web] (all live plugins as bundles); deploy-remote [user@host] [--no-build] [--credentials] [--port=N]; remote-logs / remote-status / remote-restart [user@host].
